originality.rationale: Literature searches and inspection of historical modular-rank and Kneser spectral sources found no equivalent all-size binary neighbor-parity orbit-and-basin classification. Complementary p-rank results may imply some ranks, but they do not state the simultaneous four-residue recurrence and basin theorem. Residual risk is explicitly retained. The stronger exact Hamming flip-mask distribution, including the global-complement-only phase and even-cut restrictions, is not a consequence of a mere published rank table.
